hypothesis: An independent page-start OCR probe can recover page-start movement headings missed by geometry without changing MMR OCR/CNN behavior.
strategy: non-initial page, exact Roman ordinal token plus tempo token in top crop; investigation-only
input: all 89 musical pages across seven audited sources
limitations: OCR ordinal on Shostakovich source page 11 was recognized as II although the visual heading is III; location is useful but semantic ordinal is not trusted.
post-audit exploratory result; not a locked holdout and not a production OCR change
